verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce lets users set rule-like mandates that act automatically. A purchase-intent mandate carries a declineThreshold and an expiry time, and VisaNet enforces these network-level controls at authorization, so out-of-policy requests are declined automatically. The docs also claim payment outcomes can 'trigger post-purchase actions in real-time'. However, this is limited to spend and consent controls, not a general rules engine for user-defined event-to-action automations. Missing for 10: user-configurable event triggers and actions, documented webhooks or event subscriptions, a detailed post-purchase trigger mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
